zh: 各网络互相独立。若最终升级x台，这x台不能卖掉，其余n−x台最多可以全部卖掉换钱。
可行条件是x·upgrade≤money+(n−x)·sell，整理得x·(upgrade+sell)≤money+n·sell；只要满足，先卖掉不升级的服务器再升级即可实现。
每个网络的答案是min(n, (money+n·sell)整除(upgrade+sell))。先输出网络数，再依次输出各网络的答案。
en: Networks are independent. If x servers are upgraded in the end, those x cannot be sold, while the other n - x can all be sold for money.

Feasibility is x * upgrade <= money + (n - x) * sell, i.e., x * (upgrade + sell) <= money + n * sell; whenever it holds, selling the servers that will not be upgraded first and then upgrading achieves it.
Each network's answer is min(n, floor((money + n * sell) / (upgrade + sell))). Print the number of networks, then each answer in order.

explanationEn:
## Approach

When x servers are kept and upgraded, at most n-x can be sold. Therefore x<=n and x(upgrade+sell)<=money+n×sell; just round down.

## Correctness

A necessary condition is that the funds needed to upgrade x servers do not exceed the maximum funds available after selling all the servers that are not upgraded; when it holds, selling the non-upgraded servers first and then upgrading achieves it, so the inequality is also sufficient. Taking the largest allowed integer gives the optimum.

## Complexity

Time O(q), space O(q) for the output.
